verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented documentation is a fair axis for a SaaS CRM like Dynamics 365 Sales, but the evidence shows no llms.txt, no markdown doc variants and no OpenAPI spec: probes returned 404 for llms.txt, .md docs and all OpenAPI paths. The Web API docs are ordinary developer documentation, not agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
